data.comment: Completed work pushed to dev, see commit d3146011. Rework following producer review: removed the dedicated Centipede ENEMIES row; the Centipede is now a dedicated option in the GymFodderEnemies in-panel enemy selector (enemy-gym-select), booting the shared linked-chain formation (new src/scenes/gym/core/centipedeFormation.ts, consumed by both GymFodderEnemies and GymCentipede — parity by construction). Config-tuning controls (enemy-gym-config-body) are hidden while the Centipede is active. GymCentipede stays excluded from the plain-scenes column and is not listed in any index column. Tests + README + docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md updated; full suite green.
